items.alt: An enormous oil barrel tips a falling market-arrow seesaw while worried Indian investors slide down and a foreign trader departs with a money-filled suitcase.
An older woman holds a feature phone after cutting herself free from a heavy data parcel beside a calendar marked 30.
A smiling robot conceals mechanical arms working behind its back while a skeptical safety examiner disconnects its power plug.
A large 100% customs stamp blocks a medicine carton while a specialty-drug vial wearing an Indian tricolour sash walks through a small 0% gate.
